data.description: Ability to use automated, enterprise-level tools for scanning, cataloguing, and assessing existing organizational data assets and systems.
data.historic work: DECISION MAKING: 'Investigates client requirements for statistical information, determines the nature and scope of studies, as well as the sources of information, methods and approaches to be used. Modifies existing techniques or develops new methods of collecting, processing, editing, compiling and presenting statistical data.'
data.change to work: This bullet will need explicit reference to mandatory use of digital discovery tools and triage platforms; recommendations for new efforts will require a documented, systematic rationale considering digital/AI options, operational feasibility, and full asset inventorying.
data.justification: The current element assumes informal/project-based engagement, not digital platform-mediated needs assessment.

data.description: Ability to evaluate proposals systematically for operational feasibility, digital automation/open data alignment, and risk/cost/benefit trade-offs.
data.historic work: DECISION MAKING: 'Investigates client requirements for statistical information, determines the nature and scope of studies, as well as the sources of information, methods and approaches to be used. Modifies existing techniques or develops new methods of collecting, processing, editing, compiling and presenting statistical data.'
data.change to work: This bullet will need explicit reference to mandatory use of digital discovery tools and triage platforms; recommendations for new efforts will require a documented, systematic rationale considering digital/AI options, operational feasibility, and full asset inventorying.
data.justification: Current practice does not integrate formalized cost/benefit/risk quantification, digital automation and reuse into decision rationale.

data.description: Actively collaborating across subject-matter and data/tech teams to ensure maximal data reuse, digital alignment, and enterprise value.
data.historic work: DECISION MAKING: 'Investigates client requirements for statistical information, determines the nature and scope of studies, as well as the sources of information, methods and approaches to be used. Modifies existing techniques or develops new methods of collecting, processing, editing, compiling and presenting statistical data.'
data.change to work: This bullet will need explicit reference to mandatory use of digital discovery tools and triage platforms; recommendations for new efforts will require a documented, systematic rationale considering digital/AI options, operational feasibility, and full asset inventorying.
data.justification: The traditional subject matter focus did not require collaboration on digital/AI initiatives or cross-team data optimization.

data.description: Understanding frameworks/platforms for internal organizational data asset cataloguing, their quality, accessibility, and appropriateness for reuse.
data.historic work: KEY ACTIVITIES: 'Conducts analysis of socio-economic trends and developments to assess the feasibility and impact of new or modified statistical programs.'
data.change to work: Feasibility/impact analysis must begin with digital asset scanning and include systematic operational/resource/automation/strategic assessment.
data.justification: Move from subject matter to digital asset-centric feasibility analysis.

data.description: Developing and documenting business cases and proposals that integrate digital triage results with strategic/enterprise objectives.
data.historic work: TECHNICAL ACTIVITIES, SKILLS, RESPONSIBILITIES, OR EFFORTS: 'Assesses the requirement to conduct research into socio-economic trends and developments, evaluates feasibility studies and project proposals submitted by stakeholders and makes recommendations to senior management.'
data.change to work: Recommendations must now be derived using data from digital triage systems, and must incorporate justification based on enterprise automation, digital reuse, and cross-program efficiency.
data.justification: Must be able to interpret and produce recommendations based on outputs from digital triage systems.

data.description: Ability to efficiently utilize metadata management tools to identify, assess, and recommend existing data assets.
data.historic work: Key Activities [‘Plans and conducts the analysis of statistical program data; writes and edits analytical material for internal use and publication purposes.’]
data.change to work: Focus shifts from planning new data collection and analysis to facilitating the identification and evaluation of relevant existing data assets using automated metadata systems, providing summaries and recommendations for asset reuse.
data.justification: Automated platforms and evidence-driven asset review are not currently reflected in required skills or responsibilities.

data.description: Skill in objectively assessing fitness-for-use of existing data assets and summarizing findings for stakeholder decision-making.
data.historic work: Key Activities [‘Plans and conducts the analysis of statistical program data; writes and edits analytical material for internal use and publication purposes.’]
data.change to work: Focus shifts from planning new data collection and analysis to facilitating the identification and evaluation of relevant existing data assets using automated metadata systems, providing summaries and recommendations for asset reuse.
data.justification: Synthesis of asset-based evidence into clear, actionable material requires new approaches.

data.description: Knowledge of methodologies for comparing user requirements against existing data assets to identify actionable gaps.
data.historic work: Key Activities [‘Conducts analysis of socio-economic trends and developments to assess the feasibility and impact of new or modified statistical programs.’]
data.change to work: Role refocuses to assessing whether existing data assets can be leveraged to meet identified needs before considering program changes, conducting feasibility and impact analyses grounded in asset inventories rather than hypothetical collections.
data.justification: Familiarity with rapid and transparent feasibility assessments using systematized inventories is not currently expected.

data.description: Skill in identifying and recommending enhancements to metadata, documentation, and asset structure to maximize reuse value.
data.historic work: Key Activities [‘Provides feedback on collection, processing, editing, compilation and presentation methods and procedures following data analysis and makes recommendations for improvements to established survey methods and activities.’]
data.change to work: The advisory emphasis shifts from recommending improvements to surveys toward recommending enhancements in asset curation, metadata, and interoperability, and enabling more effective reuse.
data.justification: Current focus is on survey process improvement, not asset optimization for reuse.

data.description: Skill in moderating, navigating, and supporting stakeholder engagement through collaborative, real-time and iterative digital tools.
data.historic work: Key Activities [‘Provides advisory and consultative services as well as subject matter advice to data users within and outside STC.’]
data.change to work: Consultative services become structured around facilitating stakeholder involvement in automated platforms, moderating rapid, iterative consultations, and facilitating transparent trade-off discussions centered on existing assets.
data.justification: Collaborative, real-time facilitation in digital platforms is not currently required.

data.description: Skill in structuring, documenting, and communicating transparent trade-offs and outcome-driven recommendations.
data.historic work: Key Activities [‘Provides advisory and consultative services as well as subject matter advice to data users within and outside STC.’]
data.change to work: Consultative services become structured around facilitating stakeholder involvement in automated platforms, moderating rapid, iterative consultations, and facilitating transparent trade-off discussions centered on existing assets.
data.justification: Transparency and outcome-orientation in negotiation are not explicit expectations.

data.description: Ability to leverage automated metadata and usage records to underpin feasibility and outcome-oriented recommendations.
data.historic work: Technical Activities, Skills, Responsibilities, or Efforts: '1. DECISION MAKING' [‘Investigates client requirements... develops proposals for further study and recommends changes...’]
data.change to work: Decision-making focus shifts from exploring new study/survey development to evidence-based recommendation of reusing or enhancing existing assets, and referring new survey proposals only when clear gaps are documented.
data.justification: Systematic use of metadata and digital records for decision support is not specified.

data.description: Skill in presenting and negotiating recommendations grounded in automated asset usage insights and well-documented trade-off analyses.
data.historic work: Technical Activities, Skills, Responsibilities, or Efforts: '3. COMMUNICATION' [‘Presents arguments and options and negotiates resources, timeframes and costs with service providers... and clients within and outside the department.’]
data.change to work: Arguments and negotiations will be increasingly anchored in metadata-driven evidence, asset gap documentation, and transparent sharing of trade-off analyses.
data.justification: Current communication and negotiation skills lack emphasis on using platform-generated evidence and trade-off records.

data.description: Understanding of how statistical outputs integrate within digital platforms, how interoperability is achieved, and how outputs can be made machine-actionable.
data.historic work: Key Activities - 'Plans and conducts the analysis of statistical program data; writes and edits analytical material for internal use and publication purposes.'
data.change to work: Planning and analysis must now explicitly cover aspects of digital automation, asset reuse, and interoperability. Analytical materials must address not only traditional findings but also document digital/automation feasibility and constraints.
data.justification: Planning/planning documentation previously did not require demonstration of automation, digital asset evaluation, or systematic trade-off analysis.

data.description: Ability to evaluate and document automation potential and opportunities to reuse data assets during project planning.
data.historic work: Key Activities - 'Plans and conducts the analysis of statistical program data; writes and edits analytical material for internal use and publication purposes.'
data.change to work: Planning and analysis must now explicitly cover aspects of digital automation, asset reuse, and interoperability. Analytical materials must address not only traditional findings but also document digital/automation feasibility and constraints.
data.justification: Traditionally, justification focused on statistical or subject-matter value, not systematic evaluation of resource reuse or digital readiness.

data.description: Skill in performing structured trade-off analysis regarding resource use, automation potential, and alignment with digital priorities.
data.historic work: Technical Activities: DECISION MAKING - 'Assesses the requirement to conduct research into socio-economic trends and developments, evaluates feasibility studies and project proposals'
data.change to work: Feasibility studies and proposals must now systematically weigh automation-readiness, digital workflow alignment, asset reusability, and provide explicit trade-off analysis prior to project approval.
data.justification: Current feasibility assessments lack digital workflow/automation readiness as formal evaluation criteria.

data.description: Knowledge of standards and practices ensuring outputs can be integrated and used by external digital systems.
data.historic work: Technical Activities: DECISION MAKING - 'Defines project objectives and priorities, prepares work plans and summaries outlining approaches, time-frames and resources.'
data.change to work: Objective and work plan definition must now include structured justification for survey collections, interoperability criteria, and machine-actionability.
data.justification: Project objective setting did not require rigorous resource/automation justification, especially regarding digital systems and data exchange.

data.description: Ability to assess, document, and recommend leveraging existing agency data assets to avoid redundant data collection.
data.historic work: Technical Activities: DECISION MAKING - 'Develops proposals for further study and recommends changes and improvements ... and the implementation of new hardware and software ...'
data.change to work: Proposals must explicitly consider reuse of agency data assets, automation feasibilities, and digital readiness when recommending system or process changes.
data.justification: Proposals previously prioritized subject-matter improvements; less emphasis was given to reusability and machine-actionable output design.

data.description: Ability to assess, interpret, and arbitrate among machine-suggested definitions, concepts, and methods, ensuring relevance and compliance with organizational or programmatic needs.
data.historic work: decision_making | 'Investigates client requirements for statistical information, determines the nature and scope of studies, ... modifies existing techniques or develops new methods of collecting, processing, editing, compiling and presenting statistical data.'
data.change to work: The requirement to manually develop new methods will be minimized; instead, the focus will be on evaluating the appropriateness and validity of automated (AI-driven) method and concept suggestions, adjudicating priorities among conflicting digital assets, and contextualizing these to organizational mandates and client requirements.
data.justification: The traditional approach emphasizes personalized innovation or selection of statistical methods, but the updated expectation is that machine- or AI-suggested concepts will require sophisticated evaluation and arbitration.

data.description: Foundational understanding of metadata-driven workflows, metadata registries, and how digital assets are created, stored, referenced, and harmonized across the enterprise.
data.historic work: decision_making | 'Investigates client requirements for statistical information, determines the nature and scope of studies, ... modifies existing techniques or develops new methods of collecting, processing, editing, compiling and presenting statistical data.'
data.change to work: The requirement to manually develop new methods will be minimized; instead, the focus will be on evaluating the appropriateness and validity of automated (AI-driven) method and concept suggestions, adjudicating priorities among conflicting digital assets, and contextualizing these to organizational mandates and client requirements.
data.justification: Current responsibilities do not address the need for understanding digital metadata structures or enterprise-level integration.

data.description: Ability to place AI-generated outputs (concepts, priorities, themes) within organizational, socio-economic, or policy context to ensure alignment and appropriateness.
data.historic work: decision_making | 'Assesses the requirement to conduct research into socio-economic trends and developments, evaluates feasibility studies and project proposals submitted by stakeholders and makes recommendations to senior management.'
data.change to work: Assessment and recommendations will increasingly entail review of AI-identified themes, gaps, and conceptual frameworks, requiring expertise in interpreting automated outputs and resolving conflicts or redundancies among suggested priorities.
data.justification: Human interpretation and context-setting above and beyond what can be encoded by automation will be essential.

data.description: Skill in resolving discrepancies, prioritizing among recommendations, and negotiating outcomes where automated systems may present competing or conflicting results.
data.historic work: decision_making | 'Assesses the requirement to conduct research into socio-economic trends and developments, evaluates feasibility studies and project proposals submitted by stakeholders and makes recommendations to senior management.'
data.change to work: Assessment and recommendations will increasingly entail review of AI-identified themes, gaps, and conceptual frameworks, requiring expertise in interpreting automated outputs and resolving conflicts or redundancies among suggested priorities.
data.justification: Emergent need for conflict resolution regarding recommendations derived from or affected by digital assets.

data.description: Ability to build and mentor project teams that interpret, contextualize, and negotiate machine-suggested concepts and methods.
data.historic work: leadership_and_operational_management | 'Supervises project teams involved in ... subject matter studies/reviews and/or leads project teams for special projects/studies.'
data.change to work: Project leadership will now require team guidance on evaluating, interpreting, or implementing AI-recommended methods or concepts, and mentoring staff on digital arbitration processes.
data.justification: Supervisory/leadership will shift toward enabling teams to function in digitally augmented environments where evaluation of automated outputs is routine.

data.description: Skill in explaining and discussing machine-prioritized or AI-derived concepts and options, and negotiating outcomes with stakeholders unfamiliar with digital selection methods.
data.historic work: communication | 'Presents arguments and options and negotiates resources, timeframes and costs with service providers (e.g. system specialists, regional office staff, survey methodologists, contractors, etc.) and clients within and outside the department.'
data.change to work: Negotiation and presentation skills will extend to arbitration of machine-generated options and the translation of digitally-derived priorities/results for multiple audiences.
data.justification: Effective communication requires fluency in articulating the strengths and limitations of automated outputs as well as the rationale for arbitrated choices.

data.description: Understanding, utilizing, and documenting metadata-rich sources and variable registries to support reproducibility, discoverability, and automation.
data.historic work: Key Activities: 'Plans and conducts analysis of statistical program data; writes and edits analytical material for internal use and publication purposes.'
data.change to work: Analysis and reporting activities must explicitly consider variable metadata, standardization status, and data lineage to ensure that programmatic discovery and automated integration requirements are supported. Material produced must reference variable registry status and highlight stewardship decisions.
data.justification: The present focus is on analysis and reporting; the update requires familiarity with metadata concepts and the ability to communicate variable stewardship activities.

data.development area: Interoperability Frameworks and Standards-Based Registry Management
data.description: Ability to assess and implement standardized variable definitions registered for programmatic use and understand principles of interoperability for integration across programs.
data.historic work: Technical Activities - DECISION MAKING: 'Modifies existing techniques or develops new methods of collecting, processing, editing, compiling and presenting statistical data.... develops proposals for further study and recommends changes and improvements on questionnaire design, enhancements or modifications to survey content and coverage, revisions to collection or production systems and processes.'
data.change to work: Decisions on methods and content must prioritize the re-use of registered, standardized variables and the updating of variable libraries. Proposals must articulate changes in terms of variable lifecycle, stewardship, and connection with enterprise standards.
data.justification: Current methods development does not require comprehensive knowledge or leadership in standards-based variable management or automated integration frameworks.

data.description: Skill in participating in and leading processes for enterprise-wide variable improvement and metadata enrichment, ensuring changes align with organizational frameworks.
data.historic work: Key Activities: 'Provides feedback on collection, processing, editing, compilation and presentation methods and procedures following data analysis and makes recommendations for improvements to established survey methods and activities.'
data.change to work: Recommendations and feedback must now reference the state of variable standardization and registry, ensuring improvements are consistent with (and registered in) enterprise libraries, and support machine-actionable integration.
data.justification: Requires the added skill of evaluating and recommending variable choices and methods based on their metadata, reusability, and interoperability—not just their analytic value.

data.description: Understanding organizational objectives for metadata integration and the stewardship of variable definitions across development projects and committees.
data.historic work: Key Activities: 'Represents subject-matter divisions on development projects, task forces or committees in various roles such as Project Manager, Task manager and Task Force Leader.'
data.change to work: Representation roles will explicitly involve advocacy for variable standardization, registry participation, and alignment of development projects with enterprise metadata strategies.
data.justification: Currently, project representation does not necessarily engage with enterprise metadata or registry strategies.

data.description: Ability to map legacy or external variables to standardized registry entries, and enrich variable libraries with new metadata as identified.
data.historic work: Technical Activities - RESEARCH AND ANALYSIS: 'Reviews and modifies existing techniques, methods and approaches or develops new ones to meet specific needs. ... integration of data from a variety of sources (e.g. financial statements, tax files, other administrative sources, surveys, censuses).'
data.change to work: Research and integration must account for the mapping to and from standardized variables, advocating for the enrichment and update of variable libraries when gaps are found.
data.justification: Previously focused on analytic harmonization, but will now require expertise in mapping heterogeneous variables to standardized, registered forms.

data.description: Understanding of metadata structures and standards relevant to sample/frame design and how these inform and drive automation logic and interoperability.
data.historic work: Key Activities: 'Provides feedback on collection, processing, editing, compilation and presentation methods and procedures following data analysis and makes recommendations for improvements to established survey methods and activities.'
data.change to work: This activity shifts from recommending manual changes to survey instruments/processes towards articulating requirements and giving feedback for AI-driven, automated designs, as well as vetting outcomes and suggesting amendments to metadata standards that feed automated decision logic.
data.justification: Current description focuses on process/method feedback in a manual context, lacking explicit reference to integration with AI and metadata-driven systems.
